title: 你管我干不了还是干的了我真的不是闲得蛋疼来这里溜达的
content_zh:
你管我干不了还是干的了！
“停！”唐琳烦躁出声，“我叫你给我找活干，不是在这听你废话的，你只要告诉我哪里有活干就行了，你管我干不了还是干的了！说！”
“好吧，”原本一顿狂躁的曹旦，又软了下来，“西市是帝/都最繁荣的一处地儿，是集酒楼，妓院，赌场，布庄，有钱人于一体的地儿，在西市谋活干，肯定能赚得盆满钵满，但前提是，要在西市混下去，男的必需要有体力活才行，至于女人嘛……恐怕只有揽客的份了，但揽客的生意很难找到的，几乎都有人做了，唐姐您就……没机会了！”
唐琳问：“除了当妓/女牛郎，还有别的正经的活儿干吗？”
“有啊！”曹旦回答得干脆，“乞讨！”
唐琳脸色一变，“乞讨？！”
曹旦给了她一个肯定的眼神，“对，乞讨。帝/都什么都不缺，就缺乞丐儿，唐姐若能舍下如今这副模样扮成乞丐儿，定能讨到不少的金银珠宝！”
唐琳失望地摇摇头，重新走起路，“我干脆去自己找吧，别跟着我，否则要你好看！”
曹旦歪着脑袋望着唐琳远去的清爽冷酷的身影，花痴地笑着，“真美，若是能讨回家做婆娘该是一件多么光宗耀祖的事情啊！”
西江月客栈就位于西市中心内，这会，唐琳正在西市最热闹的那条街上走着，不时地凝望着街道两边一排排的店铺，寻找生机。
要想活着回到未来世界，必需要在这里活着找到通往未来世界的时光隧道入口，否则，只有等死的份。
西市的街上乞丐真的是寥寥无几，走了大概有百米长的路了，唐琳始终找不到一个穿着邋遢，拿着破碗，趴在地上行乞的乞丐。
在一间名叫“风月楼”的门口不远处，唐琳停下了脚步。
都说妓院白日里都是关着门的，夜晚才做生意，可此时正值响午时分，这风月楼的生意，却火爆得让人忍不住停下脚步多看一眼。
此时，风月楼的门口，站着几个打扮妖艳，粉面桃花的美丽女子，她们穿着单薄，摆着弱柳之姿，挥动着手中丝绢，迎接来客，“来啊客官，里面请，今日又有新的节目等着各位看官们呢，进去吧！”
唐琳的视线，从风月楼正在揽生意的姑娘们身上移开，侧过身，望向风月楼对面的酒楼。
可惜啊，酒楼的生意都被风月楼给抢光了，暗淡无光。几位小二或咬或扯着他们的白抹布，恨恨的目光瞪着对面的风月楼，尤其是那几个抢走路客的揽客姑娘。
但那些凭姿色生存的姑娘们，可不是吃素的，一个个向小二们扭齐了腰，把他们个个给狠狠地瞪回去，“哼！”
唐琳左右两家生意楼，各自看了一眼，最后，她的身体正面偏向了酒楼，名为聚仙楼的酒楼。
她走到酒楼门口两米的地方时，那些小二就注意到她了，她的形象，给他们一种很严肃的感觉，所以，大伙儿在她走近的时候，纷纷端正站着，严肃着表情。

唐琳站在这几个胖瘦高矮老少各一的小二们面前，慢慢的，嘴角扬起了诚恳友善的笑容，“请问，你们这里用人吗？”
content_en:
You don’t care if I can’t do it or I can do it!
"Stop!" Tang Lin said irritably, "I asked you to find work for me. I'm not here to listen to your nonsense. You just need to tell me where there is work. It doesn't matter if I can't do it or I can do it! Say it!"
"Okay," Cao Dan, who was originally furious, softened again, "West Market is the most prosperous place in the imperial capital. It is a place that combines restaurants, brothels, casinos, cloth shops, and rich people. You can definitely make a lot of money by working in West Market. Yes, but the premise is that in order to survive in the West Market, a man must do physical work. As for women... I'm afraid they can only solicit customers, but the business of soliciting customers is very difficult to find. Almost everyone does it. Sister Tang, you... have no chance! "
Tang Lin asked: "In addition to being a prostitute/female cowherd, are there any other serious jobs?"
"Yes!" Cao Dan replied simply, "Begging!"
Tang Lin's expression changed, "Begging?!"
Cao Dan gave her a look of affirmation, "Yes, begging. The emperor lacks nothing but beggars. If Sister Tang can give up her current appearance and pretend to be a beggar, she will definitely be able to get a lot of gold, silver and jewels!"
Tang Lin shook her head in disappointment and started walking again, "I might as well go find it myself. Don't follow me, or I'll make you look good!"
Cao Dan tilted his head and looked at Tang Lin's refreshing and cold figure in the distance, smiling infatuatedly, "It's so beautiful. It would be such an honor to honor one's ancestors if I could ask for her to go home and be a mother-in-law!"
Xijiangyue Inn is located in the west city center. At this moment, Tang Lin was walking on the busiest street in the west city, staring at the rows of shops on both sides of the street, looking for life.
If you want to return to the future world alive, you must find the time tunnel entrance to the future world alive here, otherwise, you will have to wait for death.
There were really very few beggars on the streets of the West Market. After walking for about a hundred meters, Tang Lin still couldn't find a beggar in slovenly clothes, holding a broken bowl, lying on the ground begging.
Not far from the door of a room called "Feng Yue Tower", Tang Lin stopped.
It is said that brothels are closed during the day and only open for business at night, but at this time, at noon, the business in Fengyue Tower is so popular that people can't help but stop and take a closer look.
At this time, at the door of Fengyue Tower, there were standing several beautiful women in coquettish clothes with pink faces and peach blossoms. They were dressed in thin clothes and looked like weak willows. They waved silk silk in their hands to welcome the visitors, "Come on, sir, please come inside. There is a new program waiting for you all today, please go in!"
Tang Lin moved her eyes away from the girls who were soliciting business in Fengyue Tower, turned sideways and looked at the restaurant opposite Fengyue Tower.
It's a pity that all the restaurant's business was robbed by Fengyue Tower, and it was bleak. Several waiters bit or pulled at their white rags and glared hatefully at Fengyue Tower across the way, especially the girls who were trying to steal the customers.
But those girls who live by their looks are not vegetarians. They all twisted their waists towards the waiters and glared back at them, "Humph!"
Tang Lin glanced at the two business buildings on the left and right. Finally, her body turned towards the restaurant, called Juxian Restaurant.
When she walked two meters from the door of the restaurant, the waiters noticed her. Her image gave them a very serious feeling, so when she approached, everyone stood upright with serious expressions.
Tang Lin stood in front of these waiters, one fat, thin, tall, short, old and young. Slowly, a sincere and friendly smile appeared on her lips, "Excuse me, are you employing people here?"
